title: Wizard spell effects
description: Schema for seeds/spell_effects.json: one structured entry per Wizard spell in seeds/spells.json, extracted once by an agent from the spell text. The Go loader (api/internal/adapters/spelleffectsadpt) is the authority and additionally parses every formula; formulas use the grammar documented in api/pkg/formula. Spell ids are the snake_case slug of the English name (lowercase, apostrophes dropped, other non-alphanumerics become '_').

name.description: Spell name exactly as in spells.json

kind.description: buff = modifies a creature for a while (debuffs included); damage = deals hit-point damage; utility = nothing the engine tracks numerically

confidence.description: low = extraction partial or unsure; a note is then required

note.description: Caveats, what is not modelled, source ambiguities. Required when confidence is low.

rounds.description: Only with kind rounds. 1 turn = 10 rounds, 1 hour = 60 rounds, 1 day = 1440 rounds.

charges.description: A pool consumed instead of (or besides) time, e.g. Stoneskin attacks, Mirror Image images.

unit.description: What one charge is: attacks, images, hp_damage_taken...

damage.description: Exactly one of dice and by_level.

dice.description: Damage of one instance, e.g. (min(level,10))d6 for Fireball

by_level.description: Table keyed by caster level; first row min_level 1, ascending; the last row with min_level <= level applies.

instances.description: Separate damage rolls per casting (missiles, bolts). Default 1.

rounds.description: Rounds over which the damage repeats (Melf's Acid Arrow). Default 1.

type.description: Damage type: fire, cold, acid, force...

modifiers.description: Scalar buff modifiers, each a formula (a bare number is fine). Signs: to_hit, damage, save, weapon_buff positive = better for the bearer; ac is a change to the AC number, so negative improves AC (descending AC); ac_set* make the AC at best that value and never worsen it; attackers_to_hit is applied to attack rolls made against the bearer; *_pct are percentages (100 = unchanged).

attackers_to_hit_first.description: Replaces attackers_to_hit for the first attack against the bearer

damage_multiplier_pct.description: Multiplies each damage roll, rounded up (Enlarge: 100+10*level)

weapon_buff.description: Magical plus on to-hit and damage

ability_gain.description: Ability score increases keyed by str, dex, con, int, wis or cha. Set exactly one of gain and by_group. Groups: warrior, priest, rogue, wizard (a bard is a rogue).

ability_set.description: Ability score forced to a value, e.g. Fist of Stone sets str to 18/00.

condition.description: When the buff's modifiers apply, if not always.

formula.description: Integer expression over INT, dice NdM, 'level', + - * /, parentheses, min(a,b), max(a,b). 'leveld6' rolls level d6; '(min(level,10))d6' caps the dice. Division truncates. See api/pkg/formula.
